mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Harriet Park and a temperature of 64 degrees. Please note an air quality alert is in effect with an index of 53. We are seeing a full moon tonight, and the space station will be visible tomorrow morning at 3:26 AM, traveling from the West Northwest near Cross Plains toward the Northeast near the Madison Home Depot. Tonight's low will reach 60 degrees, and there is no rain expected overnight.

September is a big month for awareness in Verona. Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as Hunger Action Month to support the work of local food banks, and also Suicide Prevention Month, emphasizing that help is available. Additionally, expect traffic delays on Highway M on August 31 and September 1 due to utility work.

We have a packed schedule starting tomorrow with the Dane County Farmers Market and live music performances at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon kicks off on August 30.

In our weekly report, officers handled a variety of calls. Specifically, on August 21, an officer performed a traffic stop and cited a driver for possession of marijuana after noticing an odor coming from the vehicle.
Today's flavor was Turtle Cheesecake, but as the store is currently closed, please join us tomorrow when we open at 10:00 AM to enjoy tomorrow's featured flavor, Snickers Swirl.
